notes.title: Update 0.8.70
notes.content:
New Feature: Motion-Based Block Breaking (Swing-to-Break). Hold the grip button on your secondary hand controller and move your main hand controller vertically to adjust the tool’s grip height
 New Feature: Pig and Boat Riding (physical rowing available)
 New Architect Mode Tool: Decoration Builder – Allows to Place Some of Previously Restricted Blocks
 New Items: Saddle, Carrot on a Stick, Fishing Rod (No Fishing Mechanic Yet)
 Updated Sheep Model: Added Wool Tufts After Shearing
 Updated 3D Models and Textures of Tools: Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe
 Updated Block Breaking Particles
 Added Acceleration Particles: shows the moment of speed boost
 Lantern Size Reduced by Nearly 50%
 New Lead Feature: Single-Lead Mob Connection While Sneaking
 In-Game News Menu & Social Media Button
 Various Bug Fixes and Optimizations

notes.title: Ghast and Background music
Nether Update
notes.content:
Nether Update
New Structures(in The Nether)
New Mobs (In Overworld and The Nether)
New behaviour for mobs
Spawn Baby mobs from Egg by Tap on Adult mob
Improving performance
Volume parameter for Jukebox in Settings
Hand model changing (two variants) in skins window
New drop showing
Many Bugs fixed

notes.title: Projectiles, Jukebox and shooting from the bow
notes.content:
Added projectiles (snowball, egg).
Added a bow with the ability to shoot with full immersion in VR.
Added a new block Jukebox and records for it.
Changed the model of the hands.
Fixed the position of the weapon in the hands for more comfort in the game.
Increased the number of peaceful animals.
Fixed many bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
Added the ability to hit creatures with your hands.
Added the concept of dominant hand.
The buildings in the world have been improved, the chests are filled with loot.
The movement system has been changed and improved.
Many bugs have been fixed.
